what: v4.21: unequal tilt limits in a Lay Limits table (a copy of ZZLL-1, `ZZLL-TLT`) and the marker each version made (Order Editor, LADIES-BLOUSE, size 10 x 2). The marker stores ONE tilt per row: the smaller of the two limits, 0 when either is 0; the unit flag is b2 bit 0x20 (degrees).
file_ZZLL_TLT: the second version (ZZR-T2); the values of the first version are above

piece_options.W: One Way Piece. Flip in X-axis. No Rotation.
piece_options.O: Optional piece. Placing will not be required.
piece_options.U: Will not include this area in marker.
piece_options.Z: Piece can be completely inside a splice mark.

piece_options_source: the Piece Options checklist of the Lay Limits Editor (own process), read 2026-09-25
